damageTypes.name: Acid
damageTypes.description: Corrosive spray and digestive fluids that eat through armor and flesh alike.

damageTypes.name: Bludgeoning
damageTypes.description: Blunt force from hammers, falling rocks, and heavy impacts.

damageTypes.name: Cold
damageTypes.description: Ice, frost, and the killing chill of the far north.

damageTypes.name: Force
damageTypes.description: Pure magical energy, resisted by almost nothing.

damageTypes.name: Necrotic
damageTypes.description: Withering energy that drains life and stops wounds from closing.

damageTypes.name: Piercing
damageTypes.description: Punctures from arrows, spears, fangs, and thrusting blades.

damageTypes.name: Poison
damageTypes.description: Venom and toxins that sicken and weaken.

damageTypes.name: Psychic
damageTypes.description: Mental assault that leaves no visible wound.

damageTypes.name: Radiant
damageTypes.description: Searing holy light, especially punishing to the undead.

damageTypes.name: Slashing
damageTypes.description: Cuts from swords, axes, and claws.

damageTypes.name: Thunder
damageTypes.description: Concussive sound loud enough to rupture and hurl.

damageTypes.name: Cutting
damageTypes.description: Deep draw-cuts that keep bleeding after the blade is gone.

damageTypes.name: Biological
damageTypes.description: Disease, rot, and infection carried by a creature's attack.
